AIVisitNote.title: AIVisitNote
AIVisitNote.description:
This represents the note summary for a single specific note schema. A given appointment will have multiple
AI visit notes.

Contents of the note are persisted for a long period of time and then eventually deleted.

We use soft deletion so we have a clear idea of when the note was deleted.

EngagementRole.title: EngagementRole
EngagementRole.description:
A communication-role estimate for one visit transcript (engagement engine v2).

Reads the patient's *enacted* communication style from the visit transcript and
maps it to a Control Preferences Scale role (Self-Directed / Collaborative /
Directed). This is a decision-support communication aid, NOT a diagnosis or a
personality assessment. One row per scored transcript.

Patient.title: Patient
Patient.description:
Represents a patient in the system. This to simply help a doctor to find a transcript or intake.

This is not perfect:

- Doctors will end up having patients with the same name
- Patient name could be entered in multiple different ways

Fixing this is left as an exercise to the reader.
